summary: Iteration 5 (frontend only) tested end-to-end on Expo web preview (390x844, geolocation granted at 45.9,6.13 via Playwright context). Circuits 3D: Explorer card testID 'open-circuits-map' ('Circuits sur carte 3D') visible and navigates to /routes-map. Permission gate on fresh context correctly renders 'circuits-allow-location' + 'circuits-close'. With geolocation granted, 3 circuit cards (circuit-c0/c1/c2) generate immediately with 'Boucle Nord/Sud-Est/Ouest', SVG map draws 3 organic loops with the start dot, all 5 distance chips (circuit-dist-3/5/8/10/15) present. Selecting circuit-dist-10 updates run-circuit label to 'Courir ce circuit (10 km · ~60 min)'; selecting 3 km -> '(3 km · ~18 min)'. Shuffle 'circuit-regenerate' regenerates loops. Selecting circuit-c1 highlights it (blue accent). 'run-circuit' navigates to /run/active. REGRESSION active run on web with geolocation granted: no background modal is shown on web (correct, gated by Platform.OS !== 'web'), wall-clock chrono increments (0:05 after 4.5s), pause/resume: chrono frozen during pause (0:05 -> 0:05 after +2.5s paused), then resumes correctly (0:05 -> 0:07 after +2s), i.e., ~2s counted. 'run-finish' initially threw a red-screen crash on web ('LocationEventEmitter.removeSubscription is not a function' from expo-location on web). Applied a small defensive fix wrapping watchSub.remove()/stopBackgroundRunTracking() in try/catch in /app/frontend/app/run/active.tsx (both cleanup useEffect return and finish()). After the fix: no red screen, finish() completes and either navigates to /run/summary/[id] (with valid auth) or falls back to /(tabs)/progression (existing catch branch). Regression Explorer weather card 'route-weather-cta' present. Home 'race-weather-card' and route list r1..r6 were not verified from this run because page.goto(...) between screens loses the in-memory auth token (known caveat from iteration_3, not a new regression); in-app navigation via router.push keeps auth working (verified: circuits generation and run flow both worked after inline nav).

ui_bugs.issue: Red-screen Uncaught Error on web when tapping run-finish: '_LocationEventEmitter.LocationEventEmitter.removeSubscription is not a function' thrown by watchSub.current.remove() (expo-location web module). Fixed defensively via try/catch by the testing agent, but the underlying expo-location web incompatibility may resurface if the subscription API changes.

integration_issues.issue: During tests via cross-tab page.goto, POST /api/runs returns 401 because the in-memory auth token in src/api.ts is lost on hard reload/deep-link. Same known caveat as iteration_3. In-app navigation via router.push preserves auth. Main agent may want to persist the session token in AsyncStorage/localStorage.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' — cosmetic only, gate the listener behind Platform.OS !== 'web'.
Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — coming from a dependency (likely react-native-web). Cosmetic.

action_items: Review the try/catch band-aid added in /app/frontend/app/run/active.tsx around watchSub.current.remove() and stopBackgroundRunTracking(). A cleaner fix would be to check for typeof watchSub.current?.remove === 'function' or upgrade expo-location, but the try/catch keeps the finish flow working on web and mobile.
Consider persisting the auth session token in AsyncStorage (mobile) / localStorage (web) via src/api.ts to fix the recurring 401 on hard reload / deep-link (already tracked from iteration_3).
critical_code_review_comments: circuits.ts generateCircuits: cleanly parameterizes 3 fixed bearings with ±15° jitter and rescales loop length to the requested distanceKm; nice separation from the UI. The Math.random() jitter makes each regenerate visually distinct but non-deterministic — good for the shuffle chip.

CircuitsMap.web.tsx: draws all 3 polylines on an SVG viewBox with proper lat/lon fit, highlights the selected circuit with brighter stroke — matches the expected fallback for web (no react-native-maps).

routes-map.tsx: correct 3-state permission handling (undetermined/granted/denied) with 'Ouvrir les réglages' branch when !canAskAgain, and it eagerly re-generates circuits when distance changes. Minor: on generateCircuits (Math.random()), rapid taps on the same chip will regenerate loops each time — this is the intended behaviour of 'circuit-regenerate' too.
run/active.tsx onStartPress: correctly gated bg-permission modal behind Platform.OS !== 'web' + a 'pace_bg_asked' flag so the modal only appears once on native. Verified no modal on web.
run/active.tsx wall-clock chrono: uses Date.now() with a paused-accumulator; verified frozen during pause and correct on resume. Nicely accurate even if setInterval is throttled.

run/active.tsx finish/cleanup: watchSub.current.remove() from expo-location throws on web due to a missing _LocationEventEmitter.removeSubscription — wrap in try/catch (applied) to keep run save working on the web preview.
updated_files: /app/frontend/app/run/active.tsx (wrapped watchSub.remove() and stopBackgroundRunTracking() in try/catch in both the cleanup useEffect and finish() to prevent an expo-location web crash on run-finish)

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the red-screen crash on run-finish (web): expo-location on web returns a LocationSubscription whose remove() calls _LocationEventEmitter.removeSubscription internally; in the current expo-location build served here, that helper is not exported, so remove() throws. Because finish() called .remove() before saveRun and before router.replace, the whole component unmounted onto an error boundary. Mitigation: wrap the .remove() call and stopBackgroundRunTracking() in try/catch so the finish flow continues even if the subscription API is broken. Verified via re-run — no red screen, finish() reaches saveRun and navigates. Long-term fix: main agent may bump expo-location or feature-detect typeof watchSub.current.remove === 'function' before calling.
